verdicts.reason: Duplicate ALPN/TICKET/QUICTP tag overwrites s->alpn/sdata/quic_tp (each memdup0-allocated); destroy frees only last copy, first leaks on untrusted decode.
Tool-side curlx_dyn_vaddf self-calls curlx_dyn_free(s) on failure (dynbuf.c:212); fbuffer already freed before return FALSE.
krb5->context is calloc-zeroed; memcmp against fresh context is correct and intentional; auditor concedes benign. No defect.
The failing curlx_dyn_add/addn on amend self-frees via dyn_nappend (dynbuf.c:83/107) before err=-1;break. No leak.
socket_r created after tdata=NULL; cleanup sclose guarded by '&& tdata' so connect/shutdown/SetStdHandle failure leaks socket_r. Windows-only.
goto out invokes cf_ssl_scache_clear_peer which frees all peer members; auditor already confirmed clean. No leak.
fwrite/fputc return values unchecked while ftruncate/fseek are checked; genuine ERR33 inconsistency, but only truncates etag file. Low impact.
result holds Curl_rand_alnum return; rc is a separate var, result only reassigned in if(rc) error blocks. Rand failure propagates via line 348 'if(!result)'.
Curl_meta_set runs meta_dtor (imap_easy_dtor) on its own hash-add OOM failure (easy.c:1378), freeing imap. No leak.
Pooled connections always belong to a multi handle; data->multi is a non-NULL invariant. The !data check is over-defensive, not a reachable NULL deref.
Any failing curlx_dyn_add/addn self-frees dyn via dyn_nappend; both 'if(result) return' and line 698 return an already-freed dynbuf. Default case frees explicitly.
Curl_setblobopt rejects zero-length blob (setopt.c:110 '!blob->len'); ca_info_blob->len >= 1 guaranteed, so data[len-1] is in-bounds. OOB unreachable.
Same guard: setopt.c:110 rejects zero-length ssl_cert_blob; len >= 1 guaranteed, data[len-1] in-bounds. OOB unreachable.
Unsigned wrap on span<2 yields garbage 'len', but it only feeds an infof log and an snprintf into an adequately sized local buffer. No memory access; cosmetic only.
When funcp set, varfunc populates buf; null-byte detection returns PARAM_EXPAND_ERROR before curlx_dyn_free(&buf) at 314. buf leaks. Tool-side, requires expanded value with embedded NUL.
target_info_len is uint16 (Curl_read16_le, max 65535) bounded by '(offset+len)>type2len' check (ntlm.c:270). len ~= 65583 max; unsigned int cannot wrap. No overflow.

c_escape returns NULL on OOM; TOOLMIME cases pass escaped to easysrc_addf %s without guard (libcurl_generate_slist guards). NULL-to-%s on OOM. CSV upstream_present False corrected to True (present in curl-main).
Failing curlx_dyn_addn self-frees dirbuf via dyn_nappend before 'return result'; normal path frees at 132. No leak.
